# kiln

> Agentic parametric-CAD platform: turn CadQuery code into verified,
> print-ready STLs, renders, instructions and BOMs. MCP-first: agents
> connect over remote MCP and bring their own model.

Status: P4 — cloud CAD builds, a remote MCP server, and a project
gallery/build-page frontend are live. Live phase: GET /api/health.

## MCP
- POST/GET /mcp: Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint. 9 tools: list_projects,
  create_project, get_project, put_source, get_source, run_build,
  get_build, get_artifact_url, measure. Also serves a 'cad-discipline'
  prompt with kiln's CAD design rules.
- run_build is async: it returns {build_id, status:"queued"} immediately
  and the build runs in the background (typically 1-5 min). Poll
  get_build every ~15s until status is 'verified' or 'failed'.
- GET /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json: MCP server card (SEP-1649)
- GET /.well-known/mcp.json: legacy alias for the MCP server card
- NOTE: /mcp is public, unauthenticated. No OAuth, no API key. Connect
  directly (see repo docs/PLAN.md §7 for why).

## REST API
- GET /api/health: Worker + bindings liveness (reports current phase)
- GET /api/engine/healthz: engine container + geometry stack versions
- POST /api/engine/measure: raw STL bytes -> extents/bounds/watertight
- POST /api/projects {slug, name, description?}: create project
- GET /api/projects | /api/projects/:slug: list / detail
- PUT /api/projects/:slug/source {path, content}: versioned CAD sources
- POST /api/projects/:slug/builds: queue a build (202; poll builds/:id).
  The engine executes + verifies (watertight, bed-fit, support-free scan);
  artifacts land in an immutable R2 prefix
- GET /api/projects/:slug/builds/:id: status + verification report
- GET /api/projects/:slug/builds/:id/artifacts/<path>: download artifact

## Discovery
- GET /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json: MCP server card
- GET /.well-known/api-catalog: RFC 9727 linkset catalog for the REST API
- GET /.well-known/openapi.json: OpenAPI 3.1 REST service description
- GET /api.md: REST API documentation
- GET /.well-known/agent-skills/index.json: Agent Skills discovery index
- GET /agent-skills/kiln-cad-builds/SKILL.md: CAD build workflow skill
- GET /sitemap.xml: home + one entry per project
- GET / or `/projects/:slug` with `Accept: text/markdown`: markdown for
  agents. The homepage advertises API discovery resources in RFC 8288 `Link`
  response headers.

Note: requests with generic bot user agents may be challenged; send a
descriptive User-Agent.
